subject: 8th Grade Math Competition - Register by October 1
text_body:
Dear Valley Middle School Families,

We are pleased to announce that Valley Middle School will be hosting the Regional Math Olympiad for 8th grade students on Saturday, October 18, 2026.

COMPETITION DETAILS:
- Date: Saturday, October 18, 2026
- Time: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
- Location: Valley Middle School, 890 Oak Street, Los Altos, CA 94022
- Open to: All 8th grade students at Valley Middle School
- Registration deadline: October 1, 2026

EVENT FORMAT:
Students will compete in individual and team rounds covering algebra, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics at the 8th grade level. Top performers will advance to the county championship in November.

REGISTRATION:
To register your 8th grader, complete the form at https://valleymiddle.edu/matholympiad by October 1. There is no registration fee. Practice materials will be provided to all registered students.

AWARDS:
- Top 3 individual scores: Medal and certificate
- Top team: Trophy for school display
- All participants receive a certificate of achievement

If you have questions, contact Mr. David Park, Math Department Chair, at dpark@valleymiddle.edu.

Valley Middle School Activities Office
